description: Minified Bootstrap v3.3.5 JavaScript library, including components like alerts, buttons, carousel, collapse, dropdown, modal, tooltip, popover, scrollspy, tab, and affix. The code initializes Bootstrap components, manages interactions, animations, and transitions, and enforces dependencies like jQuery.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Creates alert components, manages alert dismissal.

methods.name: button
methods.description: Manages button states like loading, toggling.

methods.name: carousel
methods.description: Controls carousel slides, automatic cycling, and navigation.

methods.name: collapse
methods.description: Handles show/hide animations for collapsible elements.

methods.name: modal
methods.description: Controls modal dialog display, hiding, backdrop, and focus management.

methods.name: tooltip
methods.description: Shows/hides tooltips on hover or focus with positioning.

methods.name: popover
methods.description: Displays popover content anchored to elements.

methods.name: scrollspy
methods.description: Highlights nav items based on scroll position.

methods.name: tab
methods.description: Manages tabbed navigation and content switching.

methods.name: affix
methods.description: Fixes elements on scroll, such as sticky navigation.
